liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (1 review): The thirteen-minute opening segment into the song signaled a special performance [5]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Bobby performed the song beautifully, while Jerry’s acoustic playing blended well with others [5]
- **If The Shoe Fits** (1 review): This version was lackluster compared to the June 25, 1994 performance, which had bounce [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-07-02.sbd.ladner.3988.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 162 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd94-07-02.sbd.stevens.10980.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 2.92/5 by 13 [2]
- **gd1994-07-02.153258.dsbd.dolphinsmile.flac1644**: source not stated; 19 songs; 162 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1994-07-02.116006.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 155 min [4]

## Around the show

- Bob refused to play an encore, claiming the band was not staying in tune [7]
- The amphitheater’s natural curvature was created by piling garbage, with visible fire holes [8]
- The missing encore resulted from strict venue hour restrictions, not Bobby’s dissatisfaction [10]
- The lack of encores on July 1st and 2nd was not due to Weir’s refusal [11]
- The absence of an encore angered attendees regarding the city of Mountain View [13]
- The reviewer traded a broken guitar and ten dollars to gain entry to the show [15]
- Fans overran the nearby Safeway store as night fell and the space jam trailed off [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-07-02.sbd.ladner.3988.shnf**: transferred by Chris Ladner; source: sbd > dat > cdr > eac > shnv3 [1]. Also: C. Ladner processed the tape using DAE, CDWave, and SHNv3 tools [1]
- **gd94-07-02.sbd.stevens.10980.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD > DAT [2]. Also: Portions were recorded from the Dead Hour by a fifteen-year-old listener; Dan Stephens transferred the source using a Tascam DA-20mkII and M Audio Delta [2][9]
- **gd1994-07-02.153258.dsbd.dolphinsmile.flac1644**: taped by Dolphinsmile Producer for the Dolphinsmile Archive; transferred by Dolphinsmile; source: DSDB>clone>File cloned in Microtrack using a Tascam Dat deck> Goldwave Tracking>TLH8 [3]
- **gd1994-07-02.116006.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones -12th row-center > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-02 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-02-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [18]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - July 3, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/july-3-1994) [19]
